description: The final evidence allowlist is broader than the required hashes-and-booleans boundary: REQ-013 permits classifications, counts, and timestamps in serialized reports and errors. Narrow the final production evidence schema to sanitized booleans and one-way hash references only, and keep any timing arithmetic or failure classification transient or in a separately defined non-final diagnostic channel that cannot enter the final artifact.

evidence.snippet: retain only allowlisted booleans, classifications, counts, timestamps needed for freshness, and one-way hash references
